connector.name: Speko AI
connector.registryDescription: Manage Speko voice-AI agents, sessions, calls, phone numbers, knowledge bases, evals, and docs.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.speko.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.speko, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Speko API key for clients that do not use OAuth. Use Bearer sk_...
